name: Lake Ridge Bancorp Inc.
summary: Lake Ridge Bancorp Inc. operates as the parent company for Lake Ridge Bank, delivering a broad spectrum of financial products and services to both individual consumers and corporate entities. For personal banking needs, the institution provides various deposit accounts, including checking, savings, and money market options, along with a suite of lending solutions such as home equity lines of credit, mortgages, automobile loans, debt consolidation financing, and personal reserve facilities. Businesses can access a range of services including small business loans, commercial real estate and construction financing, revolving lines of credit, letters of credit, land development loans, and equipment leasing. Beyond traditional banking, the company extends specialized offerings like executive banking, investment and wealth management, financial and retirement planning, treasury and cash management services, employee retirement plans, and trustee and estate administration. Furthermore, Lake Ridge Bancorp Inc. caters to specific sectors with dairy and agricultural lending, crop insurance, comprehensive insurance and risk management, and digital investing solutions. Customers also benefit from modern conveniences such as debit and credit cards, online and mobile banking platforms, and remote deposit capture capabilities. Founded in 1908 and headquartered in Monona, Wisconsin, the company conducts its operations across Dane, Rock, Sauk, and Green counties in Wisconsin. It adopted its current name, Lake Ridge Bancorp Inc., in October 2022, having previously been known as S.B.C.P. Bancorp, Inc.
